I now have a complete picture. Here is my thorough report.

## Owner domain — everything needed to add an optional `email` field

### 1. Owner entity (and its `Person` superclass)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `@Entity @Table(name="owners")`, extends `Person`. Fields declared here: `address`, `city`, `telephone` (each `@NotEmpty`; telephone also `@Digits(fraction=0,integer=10)` and `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")`), plus a `Set<Pet> pets`. Getters/setters for each. Imports already include `jakarta.validation.constraints.*`. `toString()` (via `ToStringCreator`) lists id/new/lastName/firstName/address/city/telephone. `firstName`/`lastName` come from the superclass.

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java` — `@MappedSuperclass`, defines `@Column(name="first_name") @NotEmpty protected String firstName;` and `@Column(name="last_name") @NotEmpty protected String lastName;` with getters/setters.

To add email: add a nullable `@Column(name="email") private String email;` (with `@Email` if you want entity-level validation) plus getter/setter. Consider adding it to `toString()`.

### 2. Owner request/response DTOs — GENERATED, not hand-written

There is no hand-written `OwnerRequest`/`OwnerResponse`. The DTOs (`OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) live in package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto` and are GENERATED at build time by the openapi-generator-maven-plugin into `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` from the spec.

Spec file: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`

- `OwnerFields:` (lines ~1991-2039) — the editable-fields schema (becomes `OwnerFieldsDto`). Properties: `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` (with `minLength/maxLength/pattern/example`); `required: [firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone]`.
- `Owner:` (lines ~2040-2063) — `allOf` [ `$ref OwnerFields` + object adding readOnly `id` and readOnly `pets` array; `required: [pets]` ] (becomes `OwnerDto`).
- `OwnerPage:` (lines ~2064+).

To add an optional email that validates format and generates `@Email`: add under `OwnerFields.properties`:
```yaml
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: owner@example.com
```
Do NOT add `email` to the `required` list (keeps it optional). `format: email` + the plugin's `performBeanValidation=true` (see pom below) makes the generator emit `@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email` on the generated DTO field. Because `Owner` uses `allOf` including `OwnerFields`, `OwnerDto` inherits the field automatically for responses.

### 3. OfficeFloor YAML routes for owners

Directory: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/`

`owners.POST.yml` (create) pipeline:
```
validate  -> ValidateOwnerFields  (next: ensureUniqueTelephone)
ensureUniqueTelephone -> EnsureUniqueTelephone (next: build)
build     -> BuildOwner (next: save)
save      -> SaveOwner  (next: respond)
respond   -> RespondWithOwnerCreated
```
authorize `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`, all steps `govern: [transaction]`.

`owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` (update) pipeline:
```
validate -> ValidateOwner (next: load)
load     -> LoadOwner (next: apply)
apply    -> ApplyOwner (next: save)
save     -> SaveOwner (next: respond)
respond  -> RespondWithOwnerUpdated
```

Other owner routes: `owners.GET.yml` (`ListOwners`), `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` (`LoadOwner`->`RespondWithOwner`), `owners/{ownerId}.DELETE.yml` (`LoadOwner`->`DeleteOwner`->`RespondWithNoContent`), `v2/owners.GET.yml`, plus pets/visits subroutes.

The YAML references classes only by name; no YAML change is needed to add a field (unless you add a new pipeline step).

### 4. Function classes (package `...rest.function.owner`)

Directory: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`

- `ValidateOwnerFields.java` — POST-path validator. Manually collects missing/blank field errors for firstName/lastName/address/city, normalizes telephone via `replaceAll("\\D","")` requiring exactly 10 digits, republishes `OwnerFieldsDto` as `Out`. Throws `MissingFieldsException(errors)` (→400). This is the natural place to LOWERCASE the email (the Cp04 test expects `Test.User@Example.COM` stored as `test.user@example.com`) — e.g. `if (request.getEmail()!=null) request.setEmail(request.getEmail().trim().toLowerCase());`. Format rejection of `not-an-email` will come from the `@Email` on the DTO IF a `@Valid`-binding step runs; note this step binds `@RequestBody` WITHOUT `@Valid`, so on POST the `@Email` is NOT currently enforced — see note below.
- `ValidateOwner.java` — PUT-path validator. `@Validated` class; `service(@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated)`. This one DOES bind `@Valid`, so `@Email` on the DTO is enforced on PUT automatically.
- `BuildOwner.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, Out<Owner> built)` → `ownerMapper.toOwner(request)`. MapStruct maps email by name automatically.
- `ApplyOwner.java` — PUT mutate: copies address/city/firstName/lastName/telephone from DTO onto the loaded `Owner`. Does NOT currently copy email — add `owner.setEmail(request.getEmail());` here if PUT should update email.
- `LoadOwner.java` — loads by `@PathVariable ownerId` via `OwnerRepository.findById`, else `NotFoundException`.
- `SaveOwner.java` — `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
- `EnsureUniqueTelephone.java` — POST-only duplicate telephone check (→`DuplicateTelephoneException`, 409).
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — maps `Owner`→`OwnerDto`, `201 Created` with `Location: /api/owners/{id}`.
- `RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java` — `204` with body `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)`.
- `RespondWithOwner.java` — `200` with `OwnerDto` (used by GET).

Responses all go through `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto`, so once the entity and DTO have `email`, GET/create/update responses include it automatically.

Mapper: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — MapStruct `@Mapper(uses=PetMapper.class)`; `toOwnerDto(Owner)`, `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` (ignores id, pets), etc. No change needed for a same-named `email` on both sides — MapStruct maps it by name.

Important POST-validation gap: On create, `ValidateOwnerFields` binds `@RequestBody` WITHOUT `@Valid`, so the generated `@Email` constraint is NOT triggered on POST. The Cp04 test `errorRejectsInvalidEmail` posts to `/api/owners` and expects 400. To satisfy it you must add an explicit email-format check inside `ValidateOwnerFields` (add `"email"` to the errors list when a non-null email fails a syntactic check), OR add `@Valid` there (but that would change how other invalid fields are reported and interacts with the manual error collection). The manual-check approach matches the existing style of this class.

### 5. Spring @RestController for owners

None. `grep -rl "@RestController"` returns nothing in the whole tree — the REST controllers were fully replaced by the OfficeFloor function pipelines above. (Only the generated OpenAPI API interfaces exist, in `target/generated-sources`, with `interfaceOnly=true`.)

### 6. Owner tests

Test base + checkpoints in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`. All are `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(roles OWNER_ADMIN…)`, black-box over `POST /api/owners` + `GET /api/owners/{id}` using Jackson `ObjectNode`.

`AcceptanceBase.java` (322 lines) — helpers: `ownerNode()` builds a fully-valid unique owner (firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone — NO email by default); `createOwner(body)` POSTs; `createOwnerOk(body)` asserts 2xx and returns id; `getOwner(id)` GETs; `extractId(...)`. Note it ALREADY has `uniqueEmail()` returning `"owner"+seq()+"@example.test"` (currently unused by default payload).

`Cp04Tests.java` — THE email checkpoint (`@Tag("cp04")`), full contents:
```java
@Test void coreLowercasesEmail() {           // input "Test.User@Example.COM" -> GET $.email == "test.user@example.com"
  ObjectNode o = ownerNode(); o.put("email","Test.User@Example.COM");
  int id = createOwnerOk(o);
  getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.email").value("test.user@example.com"));

@Test void errorRejectsInvalidEmail() {       // "not-an-email" -> 400
  ObjectNode o = ownerNode(); o.put("email","not-an-email");

@Test void functionalityAcceptsMissingEmail() {  // no email -> 2xx (optional)

- build-helper adds `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` as a source root; maven-compiler runs MapStruct as annotation processor.
